verdict.line: You lose if you eat a Hookshot knockup into her full combo before Blade of the Exile is up; you win if you force trades while her E and Q are down.

brief.thesis: Riven holds a 51.7% win rate over 439 games against Camille, and the deciding factor is Camille's E (Hookshot, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s, range 800) — it only knocks up on a wall landing, so away from walls she has no hard engage and Riven's Q (Broken Wings) chain wins short trades outright. Riven's own W (Ki Burst, cooldown 11/10/9/8/7s) stun and E (Valor) damage block are the tools that punish her whenever she commits Hookshot without a wall behind you.

tell.watch: Camille's E cooldown and wall proximity

theirWindow.when: After she lands Hookshot off a wall
theirWindow.what: The knockup chains straight into her empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto and W (Tactical Sweep) cone. Pop E (Valor) the instant you can move again to block the follow-up auto, since Valor blocks incoming damage rather than the stun itself.

yourWindow.when: Whenever her E or Q is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and open with W (Ki Burst) to stun, then dump all four charges of Q (Broken Wings, cooldown 13s) — the third cast knocks her back so finish the combo before it separates you. This is exactly the window OP.GG flags: use your abilities when Conqueror stacks are raised.

playing.title: Track Hookshot's cooldown and walls
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot, cooldown 16/15/14/13/12s, range 800) only knocks up if she's within range of a wall to leap off. Away from walls it's just a repositioning tool — trade freely in those windows.

playing.title: Open trades with Ki Burst
playing.detail: W (Ki Burst, cooldown 11/10/9/8/7s, range 260) stuns on hit — land it first, then dump Q (Broken Wings) charges before she can react.

playing.title: Save Valor for her burst window
playing.detail: E (Valor) blocks incoming damage for its duration. Hold it until right after a landed Hookshot knockup to eat her empowered Q auto and W cone damage.

playing.title: Respect the outer ring of Tactical Sweep
playing.detail: W (Tactical Sweep, cooldown 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, range 610) fires after a delay; only the outer half slows, deals extra damage, and heals her. Fight from inside that ring or dodge it outright during the delay.

playing.title: Watch for the delayed Precision Protocol recast
playing.detail: Her Q (Precision Protocol, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) can be recast for much higher bonus damage if she waits between the two hits. Don't assume the first empowered auto is the only one coming.

playing.title: Time Blade of the Exile to close fights
playing.detail: R (Blade of the Exile, cooldown 120/90/60/60/10s) grants AD and range and unlocks a single Wind Slash — pop it when she's already committed with Hookshot so she can't disengage before you finish the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (OP.GG); the ability mechanics, trade timing, and matchup reasoning are my own tactical read, not measured data.
